macros.name: showtextsize
macros.doc: When \textblocklabel is being shown, the text appears in size \showtextsize, which is defined by default to be \normalsize.

macros.name: textblockorigin
macros.doc: Sets the position of the top-left of the printable area.

macros.name: TPshowboxesfalse
macros.doc: You can control whether text blocks have the rule around them by using the \TPshowboxestrue and \TPshowboxesfalse commands.

macros.name: TPshowboxestrue
macros.doc: You can control whether text blocks have the rule around them by using the \TPshowboxestrue and \TPshowboxesfalse commands.

macros.name: TPShowGrid
macros.doc: To display the grid, use the \TPShowGrid{<nhoriz>}{<nvert>} macro.

macros.name: TPVertModule
macros.doc: The length unit which is used for the vertical positioning and size parameters of the {textblock} environment.
